red.focus: Research legal obligations with respect for client confidentiality
red.summary: Professional legal research begins with understanding the relevant duty and protecting the information entrusted to counsel. Learn to separate factual investigation from careless disclosure.
checklist: I can identify the alleged obligation and its source
I can explain why client information must be handled carefully
I can record only facts necessary for the research question

sections.title: Find the Duty Before Testing Conduct
sections.body_md: A professional adviser promises to safeguard a customer's documents. The client claims the adviser failed. Research begins by identifying the agreement, governing professional standards and any applicable statutory duties. Only then can the investigator determine whether the alleged conduct breached an enforceable obligation. The word negligence alone is not a complete test. The researcher should write down who was bound, the required conduct, the alleged breach and the available source for each proposition.

sections.title: Confidentiality Is Part of Competence
sections.body_md: Clients may disclose medical, financial or family details that are necessary for advice. Depending on jurisdiction and relationship, professional confidentiality duties and legal privilege rules can restrict disclosure in distinct ways. A student must not upload private records to an unapproved website simply to save time researching. The correct approach is to use authorized resources, remove unnecessary identifying details where possible, and follow professional and organizational rules. The aim is to protect the client while developing an accurate legal answer.

sections.title: Create a Safe Research File
sections.body_md: A useful research note identifies the issue, relevant facts, sources to consult and outstanding questions. It should not include unrelated private information merely because the client shared it. Record dates and documents accurately, and separate verified information from the client's account or an investigator's inference. Secure handling is an aspect of professional skill, not an optional feature added after a memo is finished. A great lawyer protects a client's trust as carefully as the legal position.

yellow.focus: Verify professional duties and their exceptions
yellow.summary: Learn why ethical obligations have precise sources and sometimes carefully defined exceptions. Separate confidentiality, legal privilege and duties to the tribunal.
checklist: I can find current professional conduct rules
I can distinguish confidentiality from privilege
I can identify exceptions rather than assuming absolute secrecy

sections.title: Two Protections, Different Questions
sections.body_md: A lawyer's duty of confidentiality may cover broad information about representation. Legal privilege can protect particular communications from compelled disclosure under specified conditions. Their scopes, exceptions and holders are not always identical. A legal research memo should identify which protection is asserted and the governing jurisdiction before promising secrecy. A client who relies on an inaccurate assurance may make life-changing decisions on a false premise.

sections.title: The Rules May Compete
sections.body_md: An attorney may owe duties of client confidentiality and candor toward a tribunal. Professional regimes provide rules for handling conflicts, permitted disclosure and correcting certain statements. The details differ across jurisdictions; the analyst must not invent a universal exception whenever an ethical difficulty arises. Locate the actual professional rule, relevant commentary, statutory requirements and authoritative disciplinary decisions. Then explain what conduct is required, permitted or forbidden under the specific facts.

sections.title: A Good Note Separates the Layers
sections.body_md: Create an ethics source table identifying each duty, its holder, trigger, exception and remedy or disciplinary consequence. Include a version date because professional standards change. Record uncertainty where conflicting rules or unresolved questions exist. Such a note is more valuable than a dramatic general statement that lawyers must always keep secrets or always reveal misconduct. Client trust grows from clear, accurate advice about the real limits of professional obligation.

orange.focus: Research conflicting duties across borders and organizations
orange.summary: A legal professional may face overlapping client, regulatory, disclosure and institutional duties. Learn to map those duties without exposing confidential information or assuming a single legal order controls.
checklist: I can identify competing legal obligations across jurisdictions
I can check professional and organizational authority separately
I can assess lawful ways to resolve duty conflicts

sections.title: Cross-Border Data Has More Than One Rule
sections.body_md: A multinational company asks counsel to review employee messages stored in several countries. Privacy, employment, professional secrecy and discovery rules may all affect access or transfer. A subpoena in one jurisdiction does not necessarily remove restrictions imposed elsewhere. The researcher should establish where data sits, who controls it, whose rights it implicates, and which obligations apply. An unplanned transfer can create legal risk before substantive analysis even begins.

sections.title: An Internal Policy Is Not a Statute
sections.body_md: Organizations may impose confidentiality, retention and approval requirements that go beyond legislation. Internal policy can matter contractually or professionally, yet it does not automatically override mandatory law. A careful research note labels each source by legal force and explains conflicts. If an internal instruction would cause a legal breach, the lawyer must identify the relevant governing duty and lawful escalation route rather than simply choosing whichever rule is easiest to follow.

sections.title: Resolve the Real Conflict
sections.body_md: Sometimes two obligations appear inconsistent because they apply to different acts, persons or periods. Analyze the exact trigger and scope of each. Other conflicts require careful interpretation of statutory exceptions, court orders, protective measures or international cooperation. A sophisticated adviser presents lawful options and their risks while preserving entrusted information. The goal is neither blind disclosure nor absolute secrecy, but accurate navigation of the actual legal requirements protecting the client and others.

black.focus: Design ethical research governance for high-stakes legal work
black.summary: At doctoral depth, evaluate professional duties in an era of automated search and large datasets. Create standards that make source verification, confidentiality and human accountability inseparable.
checklist: I can design controls for automated legal research
I can separate machine assistance from human professional responsibility
I can evaluate how resource inequality affects quality of representation

sections.title: Automation Can Magnify Mistakes
sections.body_md: Automated systems may generate convincing legal citations that do not exist or summaries that omit controlling exceptions. A lawyer cannot make the tool responsible for the client's loss. Each material legal proposition needs verification against authoritative sources; confidential inputs require approved handling. A doctoral governance design should specify what can be automated, which decisions require qualified human review, and how an audit record will document source provenance. Speed is valuable only when it preserves reliability.

sections.title: Unequal Resources Affect Legal Truth
sections.body_md: A wealthy litigant may hire experts and purchase specialized databases while a low-income client has limited access to counsel and primary materials. Those differences can affect which legal arguments enter court. The answer is not to lower standards of truth, but to improve access, public legal information, legal aid and transparent research methods. A professional duty to competent representation has meaning only when institutions make that competence realistically attainable. A serious reform weighs cost, quality and accountability.

sections.title: Trust Must Be Designed, Not Assumed
sections.body_md: A high-quality legal workflow should protect confidentiality, check citations, log amendments and adverse authority, and escalate uncertain findings. It should also ensure the client understands the advice and controls lawful objectives. The final review is not a search count; it is whether the research genuinely supports the proposed action and can be defended to the person affected. Technical mastery is inseparable from the moral responsibility that accompanies legal authority.
